title: How Sehat Kahani Put Pakistan's 'Doctor Brides' Back on Call
conflicts: 'Doctor bride' statistics disagree across sources (Quartz 2017: women 70% of students, over half never practise; Khurram 2020: 23% of women doctors registered and working; WGH: over 80% of students, 40% practise after marriage; Elevate: about 50% give up); story uses only Quartz's contemporary figure, attributed. The doctHERs takeover rests on Quartz alone and is attributed; doctHERs's founding year (Quartz says 2015) varies and is omitted. Clinic and doctor counts are Quartz's September 2017 figures; later, much larger figures not used.
notes: Founder names in full: Sara Saeed Khurram (Quartz spells 'Khurrum') and Iffat Zafar Aga. Quartz and Dawn load only as Internet Archive copies (live pages 403); Wayback was intermittently refusing connections during research but both passed check-sources and check-edition. Founders' personal accounts (postpartum depression, loss of a baby) come from their own interviews in Wallpaper*, Synergyzer and Elevate, and are attributed.
